notes: E-2 Sub 1300 file (blk13 source) is a 5-page REDLINE of DEP NC Sixth Revised Leaf No. 600 (vs Fifth), eff April 1, 2025 (redlined from January 1). The whole file is the Leaf 600 summary (pp1-5). Deleted text is red with a mid-height strike line; inserted text is red with an underline. Values recorded are the POST-REVISION (Sixth Revised, eff 2025-04-01) values, obtained by dropping struck characters (PyMuPDF char colors + strike-line drawings) and verified against rendered pages. The raw text layer concatenates old+new digits (RDM '0.000232' = old 0.000 -> new 0.232; residential TOTAL '1.716950' = old 1.716 -> new 1.950; dates '104/1/235' = old 10/1/23 -> new 4/1/25), so a naive text extractor produces garbage. Changed rows: RDM 0.000->0.232 (Residential), PIM 0.000->0.002 (all classes), ESM/PIM/RDM dates 10/1/23->4/1/25, and every TOTAL cents/kWh. Units by column header: dollars/kW values are ONLY the JAA rows + 'TOTAL dollars/kW' in Demand: Medium General Service (1.12), Large General Service (1.72) and Schedule HP & Schedule LGS-RTP (1.72). Everything else is cents/kWh; HP & LGS-RTP has two cents/kWh columns, Baseline and Incremental (field 'column'). HP Incremental column ESM/PIM rows share the single per-row date column. All post-revision checksums pass.
